  narrative: Met with Greg, lead eng at a mid-sized fluid systems OEM that exports over 80% of its automated skids to Latin America and the EU. We are deep in the technical review for their new polymer dosing skid. They built this platform from scratch, so they don't have an incumbent flow sensor vendor lined up for it. Greg mentioned their chief chemist is retiring next month. Their current setup relies on slow manual batch checks which cause severe filling bottlenecks. PO release is slated for October to hit their Q4 delivery milestone.
</scenario>

</scenario>
